description: ValidationPolicy derives PartialEq/Eq and has no #[non_exhaustive] attribute, unlike TrustAnchor and ValidatedPath which both carry it. CLAUDE.md v0.2 plans to add PolicyConstraints/policy-mapping fields to ValidationPolicy. Adding any public field will be a breaking change requiring a semver-major bump or a deprecation cycle. Maintenance consequence: every v0.2 policy-field addition forces a major version bump or a long deprecation tail, blocking the stated roadmap unless the attribute is added now.
